# 🌟 VALLEY BUDDIES (Stardew Valley 1.6+ | SMAPI 4.0+)
### *Bring Pelican Town villagers to physical life: companions, living spouses, farmhands, cozy nightlife, camping, and cave expeditions!*

**Version:** 3.0.0 (Gold Master Edition) 
**Author:** Juxxan3 
**Nexus Mods Categories:** Companions / NPCs / Gameplay / Immersion / Farm Mechanics 
**Compatibility:** Stardew Valley 1.6.0+ (1.6.14 / 1.6.15 / 1.6.16+) | SMAPI 4.0.0+ | 100% Multiplayer Co-op 

---

## ⚡ WHAT'S NEW IN VERSION 3.0.0? (THE GOLDEN EXPANSION)

Valley Buddies has evolved from a companion utility into a **comprehensive daily life and immersion ecosystem**. Here are the major highlights of the new era:

* 🏠 **Living Home & Post-Marriage Spouse Routine:**
  * **Tender Morning Kiss (06:00 – 07:00 AM):** Start your day with gentle kisses, custom personality lines, and sweet sound effects.
  * **Homemade Breakfast Delivery (07:00 – 08:30 AM):** Your spouse cooks fresh, piping-hot meals, delivers them to your hands with a farewell embrace, or leaves them in the kitchen fridge with an affectionate note. They even pick up new recipes by watching you cook!
  * **Workday Schedule Notice (NEW in v4.7.4!):** On days when your spouse has a vanilla town job (Penny teaching Jas & Vincent, Maru or Harvey at the clinic, etc.), they warmly announce their workday with sequential speech bubbles around 08:00 AM, letting you know they have to head to town and won't be doing farm chores today, smoothly yielding to their vanilla schedule without conflicts.
  * **30-Minute Household Life Blocks:** Your partner washes dishes (with real steam and soap bubbles), tidies up around the home with gentle sparkles, reads by the window, or relaxes in their unique custom spouse room (Sebastian's terrarium, Harvey's model planes, Emily's parrot, Shane's Charlie, Krobus' shadow relics, etc.).

  * **Real Farm Chores:** Spouses water crops, visit barns and coops to pet animals, tend to the greenhouse, and harvest ripe produce, neatly depositing crops into chests or handing them to you upon your return.

* 🗡️ **Tactical Cave & Mine Expeditions (Caves 2.0):**
  * **Combat Autonomy & Teamwork:** In the Mines, Skull Cavern, and Volcano Dungeon, companions fight right alongside you. They select targets, break ores, spot ladders, and adapt to 4 tactical stances (*Aggressive, Balanced, Cautious, Support Healer*). If exhausted, they step back to catch their breath.
  * **Dynamic Lighting & Safety:** Companions equip lanterns or torches in dark floors to light your way, and will wisely wait at the cave entrance if your friendship level isn't high enough for extreme danger floors.

* 💖 **Organic Exploration & Tender Moments:**
  * **Spontaneous Nature Gifts:** At 4+ hearts, companions exploring nature with you may surprise you with wild flowers, minerals, or seasonal forage they picked just for you.
  * **Farmer Exhaustion Care:** If your stamina drops below 25%, your companion immediately notices and rushes over with caring dialogue.
  * **Sunset Contemplation:** Stand still together between 17:30 and 18:50 at the Beach, Mountain, or Forest to share a peaceful sunset moment.
  * **Warm Evening Drink:** Cozy up by the farmhouse stove for a warm beverage past 20:00.

* 🌐 **Full Host Authority Co-op Architecture:**
  * Zero rubber-banding, jitter, or teleport loops. Farmhands can assign all chores and activities seamlessly from their cabins while the Host maintains full physical authority over NPC world movement.

* 🌍 **Exhaustive Global Localization:**
  * Expanded from 425 to **1,030 handcrafted lines** with 100% token and key parity across all 11 official game languages.

---

## 📖 WHAT IS VALLEY BUDDIES?

Ever wished Pelican Town villagers weren't just static dialogue portraits? When a friend or spouse says *"Let me help you out on the farm!"* or *"Let's go explore the woods!"*, shouldn't they physically walk by your side and do it?

**Valley Buddies** grants villagers genuine physical agency in the world of Stardew Valley. It operates **100% standalone (no external dependencies required)**, with its own recruitment system and over a thousand handcrafted dialogue lines, while also offering seamless, automatic integration with AI conversation mods like **AliveNpcs** if installed. Your friends and spouse will walk with you, tend the crops, relax in your farmhouse, camp under the stars, swim in the spa, fight in the mines, and sleep over in your beds!

---

## ✨ MASTER FEATURE SHOWCASE

### 🌾 1. Real Farmhand Assistance
Companions are active physical helpers who work right beside you using authentic tools:
* **Smart Watering:** Waters tilled crops (*HoeDirt*), indoor flower pots (*IndoorPot*), and refills your pet's water bowl.
* **Lumberjack & Mining:** Chops branches, debris, and harvestable trees with configurable filters, delivering logs and sap straight into your hands or storing them in the nearest open chest.
* **Animal Husbandry:** Walks over to your cows, chickens, ducks, goats, and sheep to gently pet them. Floating hearts appear, and real daily friendship points are awarded!
* **Harvesting & Clearing:** Plucks ripe crops, gathers wild seasonal forage, and clears stray stones and weeds from your fields.

### 🏡 2. Organic Nightlife & Sleepovers (Past 6:00 PM)
When the evening rolls in and you head back to your farmhouse or cabin:
* **Living Home Routine:** Guests autonomously explore your house—warming up by the crackling fireplace, watching the rain through the window, browsing bookshelves, or sitting on chairs.
* **Tucked-in Bed Rest:** At bedtime (or whenever the farmer turns in), your companion finds an available Single or Double bed, slips neatly under the blanket covers, assumes their sleep posture, and drifts off with floating *Zzz* emotes.
* **Campfire & Tent Under the Stars:** If you're out late in the wilderness, pitch a cozy tent and light a campfire together to watch the constellations.
* **Morning Coffee Mail:** Check your mailbox the next morning for a sweet, personalized thank-you letter containing freshly brewed coffee!

### 🚶 3. Human-like Navigation & Physics (Anti-Stuck Engineering)
* **Natural Pathfinding:** Smooth deceleration indoors prevents wall-phasing, turns corners cleanly, and respects your personal space with a realistic follow distance (~2.7 to 3.3 tiles).
* **Automatic Gate Handling:** Companions open and close fence gates seamlessly within a 1.5-tile radius, with authentic gate sound effects and auto-close locking protection.
* **Seamless Map Warps:** Built-in BFS connectivity scans ensure companions always spawn on valid, walkable tiles across all map transitions without getting stuck behind barriers.

---

## 🎮 CONTROLS & HOW TO RECRUIT

* ⌨️ **Quick Recruit / Action Hub Hotkey:**
  * **`LeftShift + E`** (Default, fully rebindable in GMCM).
  * Stand near any eligible villager and press **`LeftShift + E`** to invite them instantly or open their Action Menu (*Follow, Farm Chores, Social Activities, Sleepover/Camp, Dismiss*).
* 💬 **Post-Dialogue Invite Prompt:**
  * In Standalone mode, chatting with an eligible villager naturally presents a prompt at the end of the conversation asking if you'd like them to spend the day with you.
* 🖱️ **Right-Click Interaction:**
  * Right-click on your companion at any time to open their action menu.
* 🚪 **Quick Dismiss Key:**
  * Press **`End`** (Default, rebindable) to dismiss your followers; they will wave goodbye and resume their regular daily schedule.

---

## ⚠️ REQUIREMENTS & COMPATIBILITY

* **Stardew Valley 1.6+** (Fully verified and compatible with 1.6.9, 1.6.14, 1.6.15, and 1.6.16+).
* **SMAPI 4.0.0+**.
* ⚙️ **[Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)]** *(Highly Recommended):* Easily customize hotkeys (`LeftShift + E`, `End`, etc.), chore search radiuses, mailbox gifts, and behavior toggles with a clean, in-game visual menu.

### 🧩 Choose Your Playstyle:
* **Offline Standalone Mode (Zero Dependencies):** Valley Buddies runs 100% on its own with native recruitment, custom schedules, and over 1,000 handcrafted dialogue lines.
* **Optional AI Integration with [AliveNpcs] (by Lucas):** If installed, Valley Buddies automatically connects to feed memories and dynamic AI-generated conversations. If not installed, it runs cleanly with zero overhead.
